# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Titles:** the “rose-red” girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a striking, dark-eyed young woman. She was considered the prize beauty among the Second Year classes at the Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a heart filled with yearning dreams and imaginations. She is a contemplative, creative, and driven scholar.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- contemplative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- driven scholar  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Mabel attended Regent's Academy as a Second Year student. While at the Academy, she became close friends with Nell Harcourt, forming part of a small circle of creative and contemplative scholars. Her beauty was widely recognized among her peers in her class year.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Background by volume

- Former student of Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>

## Affiliations

- Regent’s Academy — Second Year student  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>

## Relationships

### Nell Harcourt

- Friend of — Close companions and scholars at the Academy.  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)</sub>
